seo.title: Elasmobranch Awareness & Permaculture | Oceans Alive Foundation
seo.description: A three phase shark and ray conservation project across four Beach Management Units, growing into permaculture and water security for Timboni village.

hero.title: Elasmobranch Awareness & Permaculture
hero.text: A three year, part time partnership with Coral Reef Care, teaching coastal communities and schools why sharks and rays matter, then turning that trust into food and water security.

didYouKnowCallout.label: Why this project exists:
didYouKnowCallout.text: As apex predators, sharks accumulate toxins, including heavy metals and pesticides, in their tissue over a lifetime. Eating shark meat carries that risk forward. Awareness sessions explain this alongside the ecological case for leaving elasmobranchs in the water.

overview.heading: From the KAMAMKUKI JCMA to the Kitchen Garden
overview.text: Since 2024, Oceans Alive Foundation has partnered with Coral Reef Care to raise awareness of elasmobranch conservation within the KAMAMKUKI Joint Co-Management Area, working directly with fishers from four Beach Management Units: Marina, Kidongo, Kanamai and Kuruwitu.
overview.text2: Sessions combine PowerPoint presentations, educational films, handouts and posters to build understanding of elasmobranch ecology, their importance to a healthy reef, the threats they face from overfishing, and the sustainable fishing practices and gear choices that reduce shark and ray bycatch.
overview.text3: Key partners: the Ministry of Education, the Teachers Service Commission, the Directorate of Fisheries for Mombasa and Kilifi County, the four BMUs, participating schools, and the Timboni Community Group.

threePhaseRoadmap.heading: Three Phases, One Growing Community
threePhaseRoadmap.item2: 108 walk in learners at Bahari Hai Education Centre

threePhaseRoadmap.item5: Discussions on gear threats and sustainable fishing
threePhaseRoadmap.item6: 2026 continuation targets 80 fishers in Kanamai and Kuruwitu, chosen for high recent elasmobranch activity
threePhaseRoadmap.item7: Climate smart backyard kitchen gardening for 40 households in Timboni village
threePhaseRoadmap.item8: Two concrete water storage tanks planned for rainwater harvesting
threePhaseRoadmap.item9: Strengthens household resilience through the dry season

callToAction.heading: Help Protect Sharks and Rays
callToAction.text: Your support carries this work from awareness into food and water security for the families who share the reef with these animals.
